lessons.title: will vs going to（將來）
lessons.en: will vs going to for the future
lessons.reuse: DESIGN marks ♻️ — written fresh for S3 school/work scenes

intro.p:
will + 動詞原形 常見三種用法：
① 即場決定：The phone is ringing — I will answer it.
② 承諾／主動提出：I will help you with maths.
③ 預測（個人感覺）：I think it will rain。
否定：won't = will not。
ex: I will email you tonight.
我今晚會電郵你。
Don't worry — I will submit it on time.
唔使擔心——我會準時交。
She won't be late.
佢唔會遲到。

intro.h: going to：計劃、有證據嘅預測
intro.p:
am/is/are + going to + 動詞原形：
① 已經計劃好：We are going to revise after school.
② 有眼前證據：Look at those clouds — it is going to rain。
香港同學講週末計劃好常用 going to。
ex: I am going to join the drama club.
我打算參加戲劇學會。
They are going to watch a movie.
佢哋打算睇戲。
He is going to be a pilot.
佢打算做機師。

exercises.q: I think she ___ pass the exam.
We ___ visit grandma this Sunday. (already planned)
I ___ help you with the project. (will)

exercises.a: I am going to revise tonight.

intro.p:
was / were + 動詞-ing = 過去某個時間正在發生嘅動作。
I was studying at 9 p.m.
They were playing volleyball。
單數用 was；you／we／they 用 were。
ex: I was doing homework at eight.
八點嗰陣我做緊功課。
She was talking to her classmate.
佢同同學傾緊偈。
We were waiting in the corridor.
我哋喺走廊等緊。

intro.h: 同過去式一齊用（背景＋突發）
intro.p:
過去進行式講背景；一般過去式講突然發生嘅事：
I was walking to school when it started to rain。
While we were rehearsing, the teacher came in。
ex: I was reading when Mum called.
媽媽打嚟嗰陣我睇緊書。
While they were practising, the bell rang.
佢哋練習緊嗰陣鐘響。

exercises.q: He ___ watching a movie at 10 p.m.
I ___ writing an essay at nine. (was)
We were ___ in the library. (study 嘅 -ing)

lessons.title: 現在完成式 have/has + 過去分詞
lessons.reuse: DESIGN marks ♻️ — written fresh for S3 scenes

intro.p:
have / has + 過去分詞（played, written, done, gone…）
用嚟講：① 人生經驗（ever／never）② 剛剛完成（just／already／yet）③ 由過去持續到而家（for／since）。
He has joined the choir。
I have finished my homework。
ex: I have enrolled in the debate club.
我已經報名辯論學會。
She has never won a medal.
佢從未贏過獎牌。
Have you finished the worksheet yet?
你做完工作紙未？

intro.p:
already 已經（肯定句）· yet 未／仍然（問句、否定）· just 啱啱
ever 曾經 · never 從不
for + 一段時間（for two years）· since + 起點（since 2024）
ex: I have already submitted my project.
我已經交咗專題。
He has lived here since Form 1.
佢由中一開始住喺呢度。

exercises.q: We have ___ the performance. (see 嘅過去分詞)

lessons.title: 頻率副詞 always / usually / often…

intro.p:
常用頻率副詞（由高到低）：
always 成日 → usually 通常 → often 經常 → sometimes 有時 → rarely／seldom 好少 → never 從不。
用嚟講習慣：housework、煮食、返學作息。
ex: I always wash the dishes after dinner.
我食完晚飯成日洗碗。
She usually cooks with a wok.
佢通常用鑊煮。
They never leave a mess in the kitchen.
佢哋從不會留廚房一團糟。

intro.p:
多數放喺 be 動詞後面：He is always tidy。
放喺 一般動詞前面：I often recycle paper。
有助動詞：She can never remember the recipe。（助動詞同動詞之間）
ex: We are usually busy on weekdays.
平日我哋通常好忙。
He sometimes burns the toast.
佢有時會焗燶多士。

exercises.q: I ___ tidy my desk before bed. (100%)

lessons.title: should / must / have to（建議同義務）
lessons.reuse: DESIGN marks ♻️ — written fresh for S3 scenes

intro.p:
should + 動詞原形 = 建議、覺得「最好」。
You should watch this documentary。
You shouldn't stay up too late。
語氣比 must 柔和。
ex: You should practise the piano every day.
你最好每日練鋼琴。
We should buy tickets early.
我哋應該早啲買飛。

intro.p:
must＝講者覺得好重要／規則（主觀義務）：You must be quiet in the cinema。
have to＝外在規定、行程逼使：I have to finish my homework before the concert。
否定：mustn't＝禁止；don't have to＝唔需要（唔係禁止）。
ex: You must show your ticket.
你一定要出示門票。
I have to commute by MTR.
我一定要搭港鐵返工／返學。
You don't have to come if you are busy.
如果你忙就唔使嚟。

exercises.q: You ___ try this comedy — it's funny. (advice)
You ___ not talk during the film. (must 否定縮寫)

lessons.title: 連接詞 and / but / because / so

intro.p:
and 並列、加資訊：I checked my inbox and replied。
but 轉折：I wrote the email but forgot the attachment。
because 原因：I stayed late because I had overtime。
so 結果：The printer was broken, so I used the photocopier。
ex: She is my colleague and my friend.
佢係我同事，亦係朋友。
I want the job but the salary is low.
我想要呢份工，但薪水低。
He left early because he had a meeting.
佢早走，因為有會議。

intro.h: because 同 so 唔好重複
intro.p:
講因果選一個就得：
✅ I was tired because I worked overtime。
✅ I worked overtime, so I was tired。
❌ Because I worked overtime, so I was tired。（中式思維常見錯）
ex: The client called, so I replied quickly.
客戶打嚟，所以我即刻回覆。
I commute by MTR because it is fast.
我搭港鐵，因為快。

exercises.q: I sent the file ___ I forgot the password.
She was late ___ the train was delayed.
I finished the task, ___ I went home. (so)
Open your inbox ___ check the attachment. (and)

exercises.a: I was tired because I worked overtime.
